top_categories.workout_context: Ghost of the Gravel's alberta prairie gravel rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
Ghost of the Gravel's Alberta prairie, Canadian gravel forces constant power changes. Surge over the rough stuff, settle on the smooth, repeat for 73 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Ghost of the Gravel's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before June.
At Ghost of the Gravel, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
When someone attacks on alberta prairie gravel, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Ghost of the Gravel. Train it until it feels boring.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At Ghost of the Gravel, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
73 miles on alberta prairie gravel burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
Varied gradients on alberta prairie gravel demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.
Short, max efforts are unavoidable. Punchy climbs, gap closures, attacks on alberta prairie gravel. If you haven't trained them, you'll crack.
Double-threshold training builds sustained power with less fatigue. More FTP per hour of training.
Low-cadence force work for 3,000ft of climbing. The slow, grinding ascents where you can't spin—you push.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 40–60g carbs/hour for Ghost of the Gravel’s 73 miles. Front-load calories in the first half. One bottle per hour minimum; adjust for conditions and sweat rate.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at Ghost of the Gravel requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on alberta prairie gravel to build confidence. Expect: alberta prairie, canadian gravel, regional event.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on TT Threshold, Gravel Specific, and Race Simulation to prepare you for 73 miles of alberta prairie gravel in Alberta, Canada.
